text:
ana-security: Heads up — we're seeing anomalous signing activity from the internal SSH CA (ca-ssh-01). ~120 certs issued in a 10m window from an unusual origin. Treat as suspected CA key compromise until proven otherwise. Immediate actions below and runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ssh-ca-incident
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered by ca-signature-rate-detector (evt: ca-2301234567). Avg sign rate 1/min normally, observed 12/min. IDS flagged.
lena-sre: Oncall here. I can confirm the spikes in journald and the CA audit log. Recommending to pause new cert issuance and rotate the CA key in HSM ASAP.
mike-eng: Which fleets use certs from this CA? quick list so we can target revocation: bastion, deploy-runners, infra-hosts, inner-k8s-ssh-proxy.
nana-security: (typo) ana-security: edit — noted.
nana-security: sorry ignore previous message.
nana-security: (this line intentionally left to simulate quick correction)
nana-security: (actually back to the real flow)
nana-security: Action plan (high level):
1) Disable signing endpoint immediately (stop issuing new certs).
2) Perform emergency CA key rotation in HSM (generate new key pair, update CA metadata).
3) Revoke existing leaf certs (mass revoke; publish revocation list to clients).
4) Reissue certificates via automated flows with short TTLs.
5) Run impact window & communicate to teams.

lena-sre: I'll stop the signing service now and schedule a 30-45m maintenance window starting in ~15m. Expect ssh access interruptions for internal SSH flows. Use the emergency jumpbox (jump-emergency-1) for critical ops.

mike-eng: Quick commands for ops -- disabling signing endpoint and exporting current serial list:
```bash
systemctl stop ssh-ca.service || pkill -f ssh-ca
journalctl -u ssh-ca.service --since "-1h" | grep "signed cert" > /tmp/ca_signs_last_hour.log
awk -F"serial=" '{print $2}' /var/log/ssh-ca/audit.log | sort | uniq > /tmp/issued_serials.txt
```

prateek-devex: I can push an Ansible play to revoke certs and notify fleet-agents. Need the serial list and the revocation API token. I'll prepare a playbook and a safe rollout (canary hosts -> full fleet). Uploading to internal repo: https://git.redwood/internal/playbooks/ssh/rotate-ca.yml

ana-security: (again, editing name) ana-security: For revocation, use the revocation endpoint and publish a signed CRL in S3 bucket s3://redwood-ssh-crl/staging. Example revoke call:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REVOC_TOKEN" https://ssh-ca-api.internal/api/v1/revoke -d '{"serials": ["serial1","serial2",...], "reason": "suspected_ca_compromise"}'
```
We will also set clients to fetch the CRL more frequently (1m) during the incident.

lena-sre: I'll coordinate with infra to update known_hosts checkers and CI runners that pin CI-host certs. We'll also block new deploys that fetch certs until re-issue completes.

mike-eng: How are we rotating key material in HSM? Who has console access?

ana-security: HSM rotation steps (concise):
- Create new key (hsm-cli create-key --label ca-ssh-rot-2301)
- Export public part and update CA metadata store (/etc/ssh/ca.pub and gitops repo)
- Update signing service to use new key reference, support dual-sign for short window if needed
- Retire old key and enforce delete policy after verification

sec-bot: Reminder: Per policy SEC-KEY-ROT-2, suspected private key compromise requires legal & customer-notify triage if sensitive keys used externally. Please escalate to exec-security and legal if we confirm compromise.

prateek-devex: I'm prepping an automated rolling revoke + reissue job: will do canary (5 hosts) -> 25% -> 100%. Will add a manual approval gate. ETA to have playbook ready: 20m.

lena-sre: I'm starting the CA service stop now. Notifying SRE pager and pausing all user-initiated cert requests.

mike-eng: Will pause deploy pipelines and DM on-call owners to hold changes requiring new certs.

ana-security: Owners assigned: @lena-sre (ops lead), @prateek-devex (automation), @mike-eng (service owners coordination). Security will lead the post-incident review and exec summary.

sec-bot: Action items checklist added to tiket: TKT-INC-230123-SSHCA. Please add status updates there.

lena-sre: Checklist (live):
- [x] stop signing service
- [x] export issued serials
- [x] publish temporary CRL
- [ ] create new HSM key
- [ ] update CA metadata and push gitops
- [ ] revoke leaf certs via revocation API
- [ ] reissue short-ttl certs and validate host connectivity
- [ ] update CI runners and known_hosts
- [ ] exec/legal notification (if required)

prateek-devex: Linking playbook draft and run commands in the ticket. Will request an approval in 10m for full fleet run.

mike-eng: Notified product & infra slack channels and paused external customer-facing changes that rely on these certs.

ana-security: If we confirm signing activity was from a compromised automation token (not HSM), we will still rotate CA metadata and revoke keys to be safe. We'll triage logs for origin (ssh-ca container, x509 signer, or automation user) and update the ticket.

lena-sre: Status update: HSM vendor on-call reachable, prepping key creation. Expect next status in ~18m.

sec-bot: Please ensure all communications use the incident template. Redaction: do not include sensitive cert serials in public channels.

ana-security: Thank you all. We'll post an all-hands advisory if exec/legal determine customer notification is required. Postmortem and followups to be scheduled after containment. :lock:
